description: Strong and Sturdy: High Quality ice cream scoop with no flimsy trigger that can easily break. Beautifully designed: Not only is it elegant and stylish, but the scoop was specially designed to roll ice cream and release perfect curls. Save more, Waste less: The thin edges of the scoop can help get ice cream from the edges of the carton, which means more ice cream in your bowl. Comfortable handle: Unlike scoops with metal handles, your hands will stay comfortable even when scooping the coldest ice cream.
Easy to grip and Dishwasher safe:

Dig in with the LEKEYE Good Grips Stainless Steel Ice Cream Scoop. This solid stainless steel Scoop won't chip or discolor, even after repeated dishwasher cycles. A pointed tip scoops hard ice cream, frozen yogurt or sorbet, and flat edges reach into corners of any shaped ice cream container. A non-slip grip cushions during scooping. Dishwasher safe.
